name: Papeta Pattice
steps: Boil potatoes in their skins until just tender, peel and mash smoothly while warm; cool to a firm dough with salt.
Mix coconut, cashews, raisins, sugar, minced chili, coriander and lemon juice into a moist sweet-tangy filling.
Flatten a portion of potato in your palm, enclose a spoon of filling and seal all seams; repeat with remaining mixture.
Shape thick oval pattice, roll lightly in bread crumbs and chill until firm so the filling stays inside.
Shallow-fry in medium-hot oil, turning carefully, until both sides develop a golden crust; serve hot.
tips: Parsi papeta pattice contrasts a gently sweet coconut-nut center with a savory potato shell.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
